# <span id="aanchor405"></span> Calculated Meter Editor

## Formulas Tab

The Formulas tab is used to configure two calculated meter rollups functions: The averaging pool and conditional formulas.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 562;height: 562;" />

<span id="Average"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Averaging Pool">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Averaging Pool</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Averaging Pool">

**Calculate average of members with base direction of** - Include or exclude member values from average calculations based on their base directions. When calculating the average values of the calculated meter, the Calculated Meter Rollups service will only include members with the selected base direction. By default, both Inlet and Outlet are checked.

This option is not datetime effective; it is effective for all of time.

</div>

<span id="Formulas"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Formulas">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Formulas</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Formulas">

In the Formulas section of this screen, you can customize how to calculate quantities such as volume, energy, and mass that are usually summed from member values. You can specify a condition under which the customized calculation is to take place using a simple if-then-else format.

Formula configuration is effective only for the datetime span specified by the From and To dates.

From and To dates can only be deleted from the Relationship tab.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Formulas tab of the Calculated Meter Editor:

- **Enable Formulas** – Click this checkbox to enable the formulas functionality for the current datetime span so that the Calculated Meter Rollup service uses the specified expression when calculating summed values for the calculated meter.

Expressions may be edited and saved for a datetime span that has formulas disabled. Calculated meter data will be rolled up normally during a datetime span that has formulas disabled even if there is an expression stored for the span.

- **Edit 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="vertical-align: text-top;width: 21;height: 19;" />** – Click this button to access the edit form for each If, Do, and Else Do statement. This button is enabled when you are in edit mode. (For additional details, see: [Formula Statement Editors](Formulas/Formula%20Statement%20Editors.md))

  The statement edit button only provides access to the Statement Editor. Use the screen Edit button 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="vertical-align: text-top;width: 57;height: 18;" /> to put the Calculated Meters screen in edit mode.

- **Validate** – Click this button to validate the formulas. The formulas must pass validation to be saved. If the validation fails, a message displays with a list of errors that need to be corrected. (For additional details, see: [Formula Validation and Error Messages](Formulas/Validation%20and%20Error%20Messages.md))

</div>
